title: Hamiltonian Properties of 3-Connected Claw-Free Graphs and Line Graphs of 3-Hypergraphs
summary: Motivated by Thomassen's well-known line graph conjecture, many researchers have explored sufficient conditions for claw-free graphs to be Hamiltonian or Hamilton-connected. In 1994, Ageev proved that every $2$-connected claw-free graph with domination number at most $2$ is Hamiltonian. In this paper, we extend this line of research to $3$-connected graphs by establishing the best possible upper bound on the domination number that guarantees Hamiltonicity.
